info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Notification Subscription By Webhook Id-spec
info.description: This API enables businesses to manage notification subscriptions associated with webhooks by allowing them to remove specific subscriptions using a webhook ID. It is particularly useful for developers working on integrations that require subscription management for event-driven architecture. By leveraging this endpoint, users can effectively unsubscribe from notifications that are no longer needed or relevant. This enhances control over event handling and reduces unnecessary communication, thereby optimizing operational efficiency.

delete.description: This operation removes the specified webhook identified by the resource ID. It is essential for managing webhook lifecycle and ensuring that no unnecessary notifications are received.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters required to delete the webhook identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the appropriate identifiers and authentication credentials are included to successfully execute the deletion.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content.

DeleteNotificationSubscriptionByWebhookI.description: This schema represents the request body for the DELETE operation in the webhook context. It is designed to provide a simple string value for the payload.

DeleteNotificationSubscriptionByWebhookI.title: Delete Webhook Response
DeleteNotificationSubscriptionByWebhookI.description: A response schema indicating a successful deletion of a webhook operation with a 204 status code. The response does not contain a body.

x-endpoint-id.description: A unique identifier for the webhook endpoint that triggered this response.

x-runtime-app.description: The name of the runtime application that processed the webhook request.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a bearer token mechanism with JSON Web Tokens (JWT). Clients must include the bearer token in the Authorization header of requests. The token is typically generated and issued by an authentication server during the login process.
